text:
emily_finance: Heads-up — invoice INV-2026-00342 from Stratagem Labs landed in AP but no PO matched. Amount $12,450. Two line items: monthly subscription $2,950; hourly inference usage $9,500. Can someone advise approver/PO? cc @lucas_ops

harry_procure: Do we have a PO for Stratagem? searching our PO registry... I only see PO-98765 but that was scoped for PS work (onboarding) not ongoing usage. :eyes:

emily_finance: Correct — vendor put the PO in the email body but not on the PDF header, so Coupa/OCR didn't pick it up. PDF is attached in the invoice record (Coupa).

acct_bot: SYSTEM: Invoice INV-2026-00342 uploaded to AP by emily_finance. Status -> routing_hold (missing PO).

maria_ops: @emily_finance quick Q: which cost center should this hit? If it's runtime/infra I think 341-ML-Infra. If so I can create a retro PO and set approver to @jordan_prod.

jordan_prod: I can approve a retro PO but need the usage breakdown (hours by region + rates). @emily_finance can you paste the vendor CSV summary here or attach?

emily_finance: Pasting the CSV snippet from the vendor (only cols we got):

```
date,region,hours,rate_per_hour,amount
2026-02-01,us-west,120,0.10,12.00
2026-02-01,us-east,840,11.30,9492.00
2026-02-15,us-west,50,9.88,494.00
```

harry_procure: Thanks. If we go retro PO route Procurement prefers vendor to reissue with the PO on the header for audit. But Finance can accept an internal PO to clear payment this cycle. I'll create an internal/retro PO: PO-R-2026-118 and route it to @jordan_prod for approval.

jordan_prod: :thumbsup: I'll review right away. Confirm GL should be 5002 (CloudCompute) and cost center 341?

emily_finance: Confirm GL 5002, cost center 341. Finance will post a clearing journal until the PO is live. Vendor requested payment by EOM, any chance to expedite after PO is created? @maria_ops

maria_ops: I will set a payment hold to auto-release once the PO is created and @jordan_prod approves. If Procurement can do the PO today we can hit vendor's EOM ask.

harry_procure: Creating PO now. Created: PO-R-2026-118. Supplier: Stratagem Labs. Routing -> approver: jordan_prod, notes: retrospective usage PO.

acct_bot: SYSTEM: PO PO-R-2026-118 created by harry_procure. Invoice INV-2026-00342 linked to PO-R-2026-118. Payment hold: set until approval.

jordan_prod: Approved PO-R-2026-118 — posting approval now.

acct_bot: SYSTEM: Approval received. Payment hold released. Invoice scheduled for payment: Net 7 from approval. Journal entry created by finance to cover interim accrual.

emily_finance: Great — thanks everyone. I flagged vendor to expect payment once PO/approval cleared. Closing thread after payment posts. :white_check_mark:
